cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Bring Back Everything
cards.instruction: Return early details in altered forms until the scene feels like it has been building toward one unavoidable consequence.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You called the spare chair unnecessary, then put the birthday cake on it. Our birthday guest has the piano stool, and the pianist needs it back.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The cake needs a flat place. I can't put it on someone's lap.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then serve the cake and free the chair. Move the guest onto it before asking the pianist to play, please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We can't cut it until he's played Happy Birthday.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Ask the birthday guest to stand while we sing and serve. Pianist on the stool, then song, then cake, then the guest gets the chair. Give them the first slice, please.

reason: Prepare whose birthday it is, remove unsupported move-back history, and keep the guest standing through the actual singing/serving sequence rather than one verse only.
